Create Interactive Brokers Provider

Source: R/ib_provider.R
create_ib_provider.Rd

Factory function to create IBProvider objects

Usage

create_ib_provider(
  host = "127.0.0.1",
  port = 7497,
  client_id = 1,
  market_data_type = 3
)

Arguments

host

TWS/Gateway host (default "127.0.0.1")

port

TWS/Gateway port (default 7497 for paper trading)

client_id

Client ID for connection

market_data_type

Market data type (1=live, 3=delayed, 4=delayed-frozen)

Value

IBProvider object
